note: The abstract explicitly states 'existing compilers cannot take advantage of both symmetry and sparsity within the same kernel,' positioning SySTeC as the 'first compiler' to do so, which directly positions against the cited prior attempt by the same group (Shi, Chou, Kjolstad, Amarasinghe 2021); shared author Amarasinghe triggers own-group flag.
title: SySTeC: A Symmetric Sparse Tensor Compiler
